purpose: Phase-7C antigen-presentation structure. Separates presentation CAPACITY (largely DC-driven) from maturation support, effective presentation, and suppression. Effective presentation is the single value consumed by tumour visibility's effective_recognition stage (computed once, to avoid double counting). Section 1 establishes the contract; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1]; no MHC / peptide count (NOT_REPORTED).

coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: effective_presentation is the sole presentation value exported to visibility + adaptive priming; it is not recomputed elsewhere.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No MHC-I/II level, peptide count, or HLA typing (all NOT_REPORTED; HLA typing explicitly excluded).
